verdict.rationale: Meilisearch offers conversational interfaces that answer questions grounded in your own content (docs-1, docs-45, docs-80), plus a RAG retrieval layer (docs-64). These are AI-generated answers over your data, but they are API capabilities built for end-user search experiences, not insights or suggestions surfaced to the data owner inside the product. Analytics only tracks queries, clicks and conversions without AI-generated recommendations, and natural-language control via MCP runs in external AI clients rather than in the product. Missing for 10: in-product (dashboard) AI insights about the data, AI-generated relevance or configuration suggestions, AI analysis on top of analytics, and independent hands-on corroboration of the conversational feature.
